title: Built to Remember, Shipped to Forget: Operational Contracts, Failures, and Repairs in Containerized LLM Agent Deployments
abstract: arXiv:2610.34620v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agent systems reach production as container images run by platforms such as Docker, Compose, and Kubernetes. Framework and platform document opposite expectations: to the platform a container is disposable, while the framework persists conversations, pauses runs for human input, and resumes interrupted work from saved state; each side specifies only its own behavior, so the obligations their composition creates are stated nowhere. We present the first empirical study of this boundary, stating these obligations as operational contracts: guarantees a deployment must provide to preserve an agent system's required behavior when a deployment-platform event occurs. translated_title: 为记忆而构建，交付后即遗忘：容器化LLM智能体部署中的运维契约、故障与修复
translated_abstract: LLM智能体系统以容器镜像的形式进入生产环境，由Docker、Compose和Kubernetes等平台运行。框架与平台的文档表达了截然相反的期望：对平台而言，容器是一次性的，而框架却会持久化对话、暂停运行以等待人类输入，并从保存的状态中恢复被中断的工作；双方各自只规定了自己的行为，因此二者组合所产生的义务在任何地方都没有被说明。我们对这一边界开展了首个实证研究，将这些义务表述为“运维契约”：即当部署平台事件发生时，部署必须提供的保证，以维持智能体系统所需的行为。我们从LangGraph和三个平台的第一方文档中推导出14条契约，并利用三个独立的证据来源对其进行评估：433个已部署的开源智能体系统、在其中12个系统上诱导出的七种事件，以及从39,261个提交（commits）中挖掘出的122个开发者修复。
tldr: 该论文首次实证研究了LLM智能体框架的持久化需求与容器平台“容器一次性”假设之间的矛盾，提出14条“运维契约”，并通过433个开源智能体系统、7种诱导故障事件和122个开发者修复对契约进行了评估。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first empirical study of the mismatch between stateful LLM agent frameworks and disposable container platforms, formalizing 14 operational contracts and evaluating them through 433 deployed agent systems, seven induced failure events, and 122 mined developer repairs.
